# WK Flash

> An unofficial third-party, Anki-inspired flashcard review app for WaniKani learners.

WK Flash combines meaning and reading prompts on one review card. It sends review results to the WaniKani API using a personal access token entered by the user. The token is stored in browser local storage and requests are made directly to WaniKani.

## Features

- Review meaning and reading together on one card.
- Configure keyboard shortcuts for review actions.
- Resume an in-progress review from locally saved session state.
- View vocabulary readings, example sentences, and pronunciation audio when available.

## Pages

- `/`: Review dashboard.
- `/settings`: Enter or remove the personal access token and configure review preferences.
- `/keybindings`: Configure review keyboard shortcuts.

## Important

WK Flash is an unofficial third-party application and is not affiliated with WaniKani or Anki. “Anki-inspired” describes the flashcard workflow only.
